facts.text: Soap's drying in the basement, so don't touch it. Eat your dinner and leave the bruises out of the conversation.
facts.why: Invented speech for Tyler. The soap is made at the Paper Street house, and none of the pages I opened put drying soap in a basement. The film's basement is Lou's Tavern, where the fights happen. A real Tyler line fits better.
facts.fix: It's only after we've lost everything that we're free to do anything.

fix_note.text: It's only after we've lost everything that we're free to do anything.

facts.text: Bob's favourite. His name is Robert Paulson.
facts.why: Bob (Robert Paulson) is in the transcript and Wikipedia, and the chant of his name is real, but nothing ties him to pickled eggs. 'Bob's favourite' is unsupported.
facts.fix: Bar snack. His name is Robert Paulson.

facts.text: Shared in the car park after the first fight.
facts.why: TV Tropes has the narrator and Tyler drinking about three pitchers of beer before the first fight, which happens in the tavern's back car park. After it they walk back to Tyler's place, not drink in the car park.
facts.fix: Shared at the bar before the first fight.
facts.reversed: Checker misread. In the film the narrator and Tyler sit in the bar's car park sharing a beer right after the first fight.

vibe.verdict: The basement bar, tab and soap slip suit the film, and the deadpan tone is right, but the food is safe pub fare.
